My new partner @CrispyKat has had a sleepless weekend getting the software side of the site completed and installed on the new server. This could not have been done so quickly without his commitment and dedication. He's sleeping now, but if you you want to thank someone, it should be him.

Other reason for the relaunch

The old site was running on the CMS “chevereto” which although pretty wasn't serving the needs of the community in terms of ease of use, privacy and longevity of images. When the site launched I didn’t have the skills to alter the site in a meaningful way which led to a couple mistakes in management and pricey third party development to give the site the features people needed. The end result has been a site with a patchwork of code that I don’t feel is stable enough to continue to add features.

Early this month I reached out to the Bitnr.com site in order to form a new partnership and u/CrispyKat and I have been working together ever since to get a new, more stable and long term solution up and running.

Feature List:

Albums for guests

Users will no longer be required to create an account to build an album

greater privacy

Bitnr was built with privacy and security in mind, privacy options are more accessible and private uploads are available to all users, not just registered ones. It should be noted this security and privacy mindset is not compatible with the “explore” section that currently exists on Slimgr, and that feature will not be recreated on the new site. However the analytics stats show that it was not incredibly popular feature with under 500 views per day. I believe the trade-off for increased security for all users is net positive.

better mobile optimization

Chevereto was not built with the mobile experience users want, there are a couple of common sense design features in the new framework that will improve mobile users’ experience.

your images will last FOREVER

Perhaps most importantly, images will no longer be deleted after two months, this is because Bitnr is built around cloud storage and content distribution networks as opposed to serverside storage. This also means shorter load times and faster content delivery. While this solution is more expensive the site was supporting itself and then some. The money that was previously earmarked for site development can be used for the increased hosting cost. So long as the ad revenue continues there should be no problem covering costs.

Remember, links to the viewer pages support the site.

Developer on staff

One of the greatest benefits to this relaunch is getting someone involved in the site who has experience developing software. It will hopefully mean that issues are less frequent and get resolved faster. Additionally because it's all written and maintained by the same team it will be better optimized and provide a faster and more reliable experience.

Roll Out Plan

So we are relaunching the site on the domain Sli.mg (slim.gr was already taken). We are doing this for four reasons:

1. It can be a more a gradual transition, both sites can run simultaneously and ease users to the new site.

  1. I don’t have to wipe the current content immediately, all old links will remain active for 30 days. This is also your opportunity to move things to the new permanent site if you have content on the old site.

  2. The slower transition means that we can detect any bugs or problems along the way while providing a ready alternative should anything come up

  3. I’m lazy and constantly typing out slimgr.com was too much work, cutting those last 4 letter is the clear solution.

We are doing this because I do not have control back of slimgur.com or slimgr.com yet. When I get access back I will be redirecting them to the new site. Seriously, everything arvixe has done has made this 10 times harder than it had to be. It takes over 2 hours to reach anybody in support.

End Notes

Obviously this is not how we wanted to roll out the new site, and if you experience any bugs please let me know here or in a PM, given the rushed nature of the launch please be patient. SSL will be installed in the next day or so, it has already been ordered. To prevent a similar issue from occurring again, we have spoken with our new hosts and how a situation similar to the one that led to our termination at arvixe would be handled and I am satisfied with the solution that we've come up with.

I know that this has been a bumpy road leading up to this point, but I sincerely believe that this is the best course of action moving forwards. If I’ve forgotten to address anything please let me know.

Once again thanks for your support and as always I'd love to hear your suggestions or thoughts about this situation or the site in general. I'll be hanging around this thread the next couple hours to answer and questions or comments.

Does clicking ads on sli.mg produce revenue for you guys?

Short answer: yes

Long answer: Google adsense has a hybrid way of determining the value of an ad placed. They give you a rate in per thousand ads (RPM), but the rate is determined by the number of ads loaded, the number of ads viewed (actually appears on the screen) and the number of clicks on your ads. As far as I can tell the number of clicks is the most important factor in determining the RPM, and more clicks will result in a high RPM and therefore more revenue.
